What we do best

Three things, done right. Tell us what you want and we’ll shape it.

  • Fades

    Low, mid, high or skin. Blended tight and finished with a crisp line-up.

  • Beards

    Trims, shape-ups and full reshapes, from overgrown to sharp.

  • Kids cuts

    Patient hands and a clean result, from the first haircut to back-to-school.
